name: Whisker Ward
summary: A black-and-white care desk for a vet clinic with a live ward round and patient flow
about: An eight-page care desk for a small-animal vet clinic, drawn in black and white with colour only where something needs attention. A live ward round steps a scanning line across the kennels while medicine countdowns tick, and the app also runs a patient flow board, a drag-and-drop vet schedule, pet records with weight and vaccines, owners, a pharmacy with a controlled-drug log and billing.
how: Open Care desk: drag pets through Booked, Waiting, In consult, Treatment and Ready to go, or use the arrow menu
Open Ward round and press Start: a red scanning line moves kennel by kennel while you tick fed, meds, vitals and cleaned
Watch medicine countdowns tick each second and turn amber, then red, when a dose is late; click a kennel to give it
Drag bookings between vets, days and times in Appointments, or click one for quick moves and calls
Open a pet for its weight chart, vaccines and history; record a vaccine or book a visit
Dispense medicine to bill it and log controlled drugs, then take payments in Billing with 7D, 30D and 12M views
Switch the paper-white or night-ward theme and reset the demo data in Settings
